arxiv-2006-09776.title: Critical region in the spatiotemporal dynamics of a turbulent thermoacoustic system and smart passive control Journal: Combustion and Flame
arxiv-2006-09776.creator: Amitesh Roy, C P Premchand, Manikandan Raghunathan, Abin Krishnan, Vineeth Nair, R I Sujith
arxiv-2006-09776.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Amitesh Roy, C P Premchand, Manikandan Raghunathan, Abin Krishnan, Vineeth Nair, R I Sujith. We develop a passive control strategy for suppressing thermoacoustic instability in a bluff-body stabilized premixed turbulent combustor. When the equivalence ratio is varied, there is a transition from combustion noise to thermoacoustic instability via intermittency in the combustor. We perform simultaneous acoustic pressure, 2D-PIV, and CH ∗ chemiluminescence measurements to capture the pressure fluctuations, the velocity field, and the heat release rate (HRR) field during the transition.

arxiv-2106-02813.title: Machine learning equipped web based disease prediction and recommender system
arxiv-2106-02813.creator: Harish Rajora, Narinder Singh Punn, Sanjay Kumar Sonbhadra, Sonali Agarwal
arxiv-2106-02813.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Harish Rajora, Narinder Singh Punn, Sanjay Kumar Sonbhadra, Sonali Agarwal. Worldwide, several cases go undiagnosed due to poor healthcare support in remote areas. In this context, a centralized system is needed for effective monitoring and analysis of the medical records. A web-based patient diagnostic system is a central platform to store the medical history and predict the possible disease based on the current symptoms experienced by a patient to ensure faster and accurate diagnosis.

arxiv-2306-17480.title: Constraints on thermalizing surfaces from infrared observations of supermassive black holes
arxiv-2306-17480.creator: Raúl Carballo-Rubio, Francesco Di Filippo, Stefano Liberati, Matt Visser
arxiv-2306-17480.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Raúl Carballo-Rubio, Francesco Di Filippo, Stefano Liberati, Matt Visser. Infrared observations of Sgr A ∗ and M87 ∗ are incompatible with the assumption that these sources have physical surfaces in thermal equilibrium with their accreting environments. In this paper we discuss a general parametrization of the energy balance in a horizonless object, which permits to quantify how close a horizonless object is in its behavior to a black hole, and analyze the timescale in which its surface can thermalize.

arxiv-2312-16013.title: Four-dimensional Floquet topological insulator with an emergent second Chern number
arxiv-2312-16013.creator: Zheng-Rong Liu, Rui Chen, Bin Zhou
arxiv-2312-16013.description: Abstract Floquet topological insulators have been widely investigated in lower-dimensional systems. However, Floquet topological insulators induced by time-periodic driving in higher-dimensional systems remain unexplored. In this work, we study the effects of time-periodic driving in a four-dimensional (4D) normal insulator, focusing on topological phase transitions at the resonant quasienergy gap.

arxiv-2401-17206.title: Gazetteer-Enhanced Bangla Named Entity Recognition with BanglaBERT Semantic Embeddings K-Means-Infused CRF Model
arxiv-2401-17206.creator: Niloy Farhan, Saman Sarker Joy, Tafseer Binte Mannan, Farig SadequeDepartment of Computer Science and EngineeringBRAC University Merul Badda, Dhaka - 1212, Bangladesh {niloy.farhan, saman.sarker.joy, tafseer.binte.mannan}@g.bracu.ac.bd, farig.sadeque@bracu.ac.bd
arxiv-2401-17206.description: Abstract Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a sub-task of Natural Language Processing (NLP) that distinguishes entities from unorganized text into predefined categorization. In recent years, a lot of Bangla NLP subtasks have received quite a lot of attention; but Named Entity Recognition in Bangla still lags behind.

arxiv-2411-00977.title: Extreme Value Statistics of Community Detection in Complex Networks with Reduced Network Extremal Ensemble Learning (RenEEL)
arxiv-2411-00977.creator: Tania Ghosh, R.K.P. Zia, Kevin E. Bassler*
arxiv-2411-00977.description: Abstract Arguably, the most fundamental problem in Network Science is finding structure within a complex network. One approach is to partition the nodes into communities that are more densely connected than one expects in a random network. “The” community structure then corresponds to the partition that maximizes Modularity, an objective function that quantifies this idea.

arxiv-2411-17227.title: Uniformization of gasket Julia sets Thanks: The first-named author was partially supported by NSF Grant DMS-2349929. Thanks: The second-named author was partially supported by NSF Grant DMS-2246485
arxiv-2411-17227.creator: Yusheng Luo, Dimitrios Ntalampekos
arxiv-2411-17227.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yusheng Luo, Dimitrios Ntalampekos. The object of the paper is to characterize gasket Julia sets of rational maps that can be uniformized by round gaskets. We restrict to rational maps without critical points on the Julia set. Under these conditions, we prove that a Julia set can be quasiconformally uniformized by a round gasket if and only if it is a fat gasket, i.e., boundaries of Fatou components intersect tangentially.

arxiv-2506-20259.title: Generating and Customizing Robotic Arm Trajectories using Neural Networks
arxiv-2506-20259.creator: Andrej Lúčny, Matilde Antonj, Carlo Mazzola, Hana Hornáčková, Igor Farkaš
arxiv-2506-20259.description: Abstract We introduce a neural network approach for generating and customizing the trajectory of a robotic arm, that guarantees precision and repeatability. To highlight the potential of this novel method, we describe the design and implementation of the technique and show its application in an experimental setting of cognitive robotics.

Initially identified by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), we extensively monitored these targets with the Antarctic Search for Transiting Exoplanets (ASTEP), supported by other facilities in the TESS Follow-Up (TFOP) network. Aims.

arxiv-2511-00842.title: Kostant relation in filtered randomized benchmarking for passive bosonic devices
arxiv-2511-00842.creator: David Amaro-Alcalá
arxiv-2511-00842.description: Abstract We reduce the cost of the current bosonic randomized benchmarking proposal. First, we introduce a filter function using immanants. With this filter, we avoid the need to compute Clebsch–Gordan coefficients. Our filter uses the same data as the original, although we propose a distinct data collection process that requires a single type of measurement.

britannica-1911-rush-richard.title: Rush, Richard (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-rush-richard.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-rush-richard.description: Article 'Rush, Richard' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. diplomatist, son of Dr Benjamin Rush, was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on the 29th of August 1780 He graduated at Princeton in 1797, and was admitted to the bar in 1800. He was attorney-general of Pennsylvania in 1811, comptroller of the treasury of the United States in 1811–14, attorney general in the cabinet of President James Madison in 1814–17, acting secretary of state from March to September 1817, minister.

pmc-10601145.title: Telomere and subtelomere high polymorphism might contribute to the specificity of homologous recognition and pairing during meiosis in barley in the context of breeding
pmc-10601145.creator: I M Serrano-León, P Prieto, M Aguilar
pmc-10601145.description: Barley (Hordeum vulgare) is one of the most popular cereal crops globally. Although it is a diploid species, (2n = 2x = 14) the study of its genome organization is necessary in the framework of plant breeding since barley is often used in crosses with other cereals like wheat to provide them with advantageous characters.

pmc-11385796.title: The expression of programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) involves in the clinicopathologic characteristics and prognostic implications of testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT): a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11385796.creator: Peifeng Li, Yuwei Zhong, Miaotao Zhang, Yonghong Zheng, Wei Peng
pmc-11385796.description: BackgroundTesticular germ cell tumor (TGCT) is a type of tumor with relatively lower incidence but being more prevalent in young men. The expression of programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) serves as a potential biomarker for predicting the survival outcomes of other tumors.

pmc-11471602.title: Visualizing multimerization of plasticity-related gene 5 at the plasma membrane using FLIM-FRET
pmc-11471602.creator: Franziska Köper, Danara Vonk, Malte W. Dirksen, Isabel Gross, Axel Heep, Torsten Plösch, Mark S. Hipp, Anja U. Bräuer
pmc-11471602.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Plasticity-related gene (PRG) 5 is a vertebrate specific membrane protein, that belongs to the family of lipid-phosphate phosphatases (LPPs). It is prominently expressed in neurons and is involved in cellular processes such as growth-cone guidance and spine formation. At a functional level, PRG5 induces filopodia in non-neuronal cell lines, as well as the formation of plasma membrane protrusions in primary cortical and hippocampal neurons.

pmc-11487333.title: Correction to “The role of nurses and midwives in medical laboratory investigations in sub‐Saharan Africa”
pmc-11487333.creator: Unknown
pmc-11487333.description: ften contact the patient, providing direct care as directed by medical doctors or clinical officers. In these settings, these diagnosticians are general or specialist medical doctors.

pmc-11598024.title: Chemical Composition, In Silico Investigations and Evaluation of Antifungal, Antibacterial, Insecticidal and Repellent Activities of Eucalyptus camaldulensis Dehn. Leaf Essential Oil from ALGERIA
pmc-11598024.creator: Ghozlane Barboucha, Noureddine Rahim, Houssem Boulebd, Amina Bramki, Anna Andolfi, Maria Michela Salvatore, Marco Masi, Katarina Šavikin, Dušanka Kitić, Milica Randjelović
pmc-11598024.description: This study investigated the phytochemical profile and evaluated the antimicrobial and insecticidal properties of Eucalyptus camaldulensis Dehn. essential oil (EC-EO) from Algeria, using in vitro and in silico approaches. The yield of EC-EO was 0.27%, with gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) revealing spathulenol (58.24%), cryptone (17.22%), and o-cymene (15.53%) as the major compounds.

pmc-12396979.title: Label-free diagnostic procedure for hirschsprung’s disease to detect intestinal mucosal characteristics of aganglionosis by Raman spectroscopy with optimized decision algorithms
pmc-12396979.creator: Yusuke Oshima, Yuki Matsumoto, Katsuhiro Ogawa, Kai Tamura, Rena Yagi, Noritaka Fujisawa, Takashi Katagiri, Shun Onishi, Hidefumi Shiroshita, Tsuyoshi Etho, Tsutomu Daa, Satoshi Ieiri, Masafumi Inomata
pmc-12396979.description: PurposeHirschsprung’s disease (HSCR) is an intestinal disorder characterized by the absence of nerve cells in parts of the intestinal tract. The definitive diagnosis is confirmed by a full-thickness rectal biopsy to verify the absence of ganglion cells. However, incomplete removal often causes post-operative complications.

pmc-12513109.title: Relevance of a peripheral site of action outside the brain-blood barrier for the beneficial effects of CB2 receptor activation in experimental ALS in male mice
pmc-12513109.creator: Marta Gómez-Almería, Claudia Gonzalo-Consuegra, Carmen Rodríguez-Cueto, María Cabañas-Cotillas, Alberto Jiménez-Amor, Isabel Machín-Díaz, Matthias B. Wittwer, Pawel Dzygiel, Diego Clemente, Uwe Grether, Javier Fernández-Ruiz, Eva de Lago
pmc-12513109.description: BACKGROUND. Cannabinoid type 2 receptor (CB2) activation works against neurotoxic events that kill motor neurons in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Given that amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is a neuromuscular pathology with the skeletal muscle being also affected, we were interested in deciphering whether peripheral CB2 may contribute in these beneficial effects. METHODS.

pmc-12647655.title: Proteomics discovery of MTDH and SND1 interaction vulnerabilities in ovarian cancer
pmc-12647655.creator: Parisa Esmaeili, Ahmad Nasimian, Lucas Werner, Sergio Mosquim Junior, Magnus E. Jakobsson, Anna Sandström Gerdtsson, Julhash U. Kazi, Fredrik Levander
pmc-12647655.description: High-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) is the most prevalent and aggressive subtype of ovarian cancer. The combination of late-stage diagnosis and the tendency to exhibit resistance to existing treatments highlights a critical gap in effective therapeutic options. There is thus a need for novel strategies for targeting HGSOC, particularly in its advanced stages.

pmc-12707744.title: Development of a simple trap using widely available materials for collecting immature Sabethines (Diptera: Culicidae) and first records of Sabethes batesi and Wyeomyia nigritubus in Sergipe, Brazil
pmc-12707744.creator: David Campos Andrade, João Victor Santos França, Rafael Oliveira Christe, Mauro Toledo Marrelli, Roseli La Corte
pmc-12707744.description: Background: The collection of immature Sabethines from natural habitats is challenging. Objective: To develop a low-cost and effective trap using widely available materials. Methods: A perforated coconut endocarp filled with water was installed in the Atlantic Forest of Sergipe. Results: Sabethes albiprivus, Sa. batesi, Toxorhynchites theobaldi, and Wyeomyia nigritubus were identified after collection and rearing.
